name: lightcraft-mcp-server
description: Develop photos and raw files (auto tone, white balance, 114 sliders, presets, profiles, masks, spot healing, crop), merge HDR and panoramas, cull by sharpness and export JPEG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF or DNG, using the LightCraft raw developer installed on Windows, macOS or Linux. Not affiliated with LightCraft or Storytold.
long_description:
LightCraft Bridge lets Claude develop your photos with the LightCraft you already have installed on Windows, macOS or Linux (tested with 0.4.0), the open-source, Lightroom-class raw developer written in Rust.

- **Develop**: raw (DNG, CR2, CR3, ARW, NEF, RAF, RW2, PEF, ORF, SRW) and JPEG / TIFF / PNG photos with auto tone, white balance (presets, Kelvin, eyedropper), any of the 114 develop sliders (exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, texture, clarity, dehaze, vibrance, colour mixer, colour grading, tone curve, vignette, grain, sharpening, noise reduction, lens corrections), presets and profiles (Lightroom .xmp / .lrtemplate presets too), black & white, crop and straighten, upright, spot healing, dust and red-eye removal, and masks (graduated, radial, luminance, colour, brush, subject, sky) with local adjustments. One photo or whole folders.
- **Merge**: HDR from brackets, panoramas and HDR panoramas, as editable DNG.
- **Cull**: score a shoot for focus and clipping, group bursts and keep the sharpest.
- **Export**: JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF and DNG with size, quality, file-size limit, colour space, bit depth, output sharpening, metadata policy and watermark.
- **Preview** any photo with a trial look, and run any of LightCraft's 240 commands, headless or in the open app.

The connector drives LightCraft's own headless engine (lightcraft-cli) with a throwaway library: your originals are only read, your LightCraft library is never touched unless you ask, and nothing is overwritten. Everything runs locally with no network access. LightCraft is an open-source project by Storytold; this connector is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

lightcraft_dir.title: LightCraft folder
lightcraft_dir.description: Install folder of LightCraft (or LightCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\LightCraft, /Applications/LightCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/lightcraft or PATH.

lightcraft_cli.title: lightcraft-cli executable (optional)
lightcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped lightcraft-cli-<version>-macos-universal.zip on macOS.

control_port.title: LightCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the LightCraft app (run_lightcraft_commands live). Default 7980.
